===Links=== *[https://wiki.sipeed.com/hardware/en/lichee/K1/lm3a.html ''LicheePi Module 3A'' on '''SiPEED Wiki'''] *[https://www.cnx-software.com/2024/09/05/licheepi-3a-a-spacemit-k1-risc-v-development-board-with-som-and-carrier-board/ ''LicheePi 3A - A SpacemIT K1 RISC-V development board'' on '''CNX-Software'''] *[https://linuxgizmos.com/risc-v-based-lichee-pi-3a-with-16gb-ram-and-pcie-support/ ''RISC-V Based Lichee Pi 3A with 16GB RAM and PCIe Support'' on '''LinuxGizmos''']
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[SpacemiT]] ''Key Stone'' K1 (X60) @1.6GHz :SoC: Octa-Core RISC-V (RV64GC) 64-bit :NPU: 2.0 TOPS (AI from RlSC-V Core) *GPU: ''Imagination'' BXE-2-32 @819MHz :32KB SLC (OpenGL ES3.2) :VPU: H.264/H.265 decoder up to 4Kp60, :H.265 encoder up to 4Kp30 *Storage: 32GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash (''[[Rayson]]'') *Memory: 8GB (LPDDR4X) SDRAM (''[[Biwin]]'') *Network: 2x GbE ports *Power Source: 5V/2A via SODIMM Connector
